arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds. The cron drift issue was caused by a misconfiguration of the schedule. The failed-jobs backlog was due to 47 malformed rows in the failed_jobs table, which have been deleted. Pgbouncer was restarted to ensure the changes take effect.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Monitor the system for any residual issues and ensure the cron jobs are correctly configured. Additionally, improve the validation process to prevent malformed jobs from entering the failed_jobs table in the future.
